title: Format the TypeScript sources with Prettier and check formatting in CI
description:
The repository has no formatter or linter for TypeScript. `accounts/` uses one-space indentation, several statements per line and 900-character boolean chains; `src/` and `server/` use two-space indentation. Reviews cannot read the accounts code line by line.

Scope:
- Add a Prettier configuration (`printWidth` 110) and format every `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.mjs`, `.js` source. No behavior change.
- Add `npm run lint` (Prettier check) and `npm run format`, and run lint in CI before typecheck.
- Every later review fix branches from this change so its diff shows only its own edits.

Acceptance: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run check --prefix infra` pass on the formatted tree. PR #18 should merge before this lands, then the formatting is re-run on the merged `main`.
